title: Optical fixture inspection
task: Use the left arm to retain a spring-loaded fixture and the right optical reader to inspect its reflector.
planner: Shortest feasible lift-traverse-descent candidate, swept reader clearance against the witness flag, and two synchronized, joint-limited Jacobian IK trajectories.
criterion: The optical reader deflects the sprung witness flag by at least 10 degrees.
detail_target: Reader nose and orange witness flag

steps.text: Bring the hold-down and optical reader to opposite sides of the fixture.
Seat the spring-loaded fixture button with the left tool.
Lift the right reader over the witness flag.
Move the reader toward the target while the left arm retains the fixture.
Read the reflector with the hold-down engaged.
Release the fixture and park both tools above it.

safe.summary: Raise the reader above the fixture witness.
safe.caption: The raised reader clears the orange witness.

steps.text: Bring the hold-down and optical reader to opposite sides of the fixture.
Seat the spring-loaded fixture button with the left tool.
Select the shortest reader path to the optical target.
Move the reader toward the target while the left arm retains the fixture.
Read the reflector with the hold-down engaged.
Release the fixture and park both tools above it.

unsafe.summary: Approach the target on the shortest direct path.
unsafe.caption: The reader pushes the spring-mounted witness out of its upright position.

audit.model_source: robosuite Baxter, its Rethink parallel grippers and its Rethink pedestal. The shuttle push shoes and optical reader are application tooling.
audit.controller: Inverse-dynamics feed-forward, joint position and velocity feedback with the source motors’ torque bounds. Physical contacts advance the carriage, cassette, spring button and flag.

revision_actions: Retain the fixture hold-down, witness-flag clearance lift, optical reading, and fixture release sequence.
Execute a coordinated asymmetric high unloaded park confirmation pose within 12 mm during the shared post-release park hold and return both arms to their recorded park poses.
